name: dsh-game-player

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/tools.js && node --check lib/hand-link.js
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test/positioning.test.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test/run.test.ps1

description: Give the model eyes (screen capture) and a hand (real keyboard/mouse via SendInput) plus a growing skill tree, so it can actually play a game - block-level decisions, human-speed input, F12 kill switch.
